title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 200 West North Street in Normal, Illinois, as the "Sgt. Josh Rodgers Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 200 West North Street in Normal, Illinois, as the "Sgt. Josh Rodgers Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a Postal Service facility in Normal, Illinois, after Sergeant Josh Rodgers.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 200 West North Street in Normal, Illinois, as the "Sgt. Josh Rodgers Post Office." It is a naming measure and does not change postal services, rules, or costs. The name honors Sergeant Josh Rodgers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 21, 2018.
